name: coupling_iface
reviewed: wave-1 adversarial review (muse-spark-free) + composability review; findings manually verified against realized code before adoption
path: configs/contracts/coupling_iface.json; implementation src/jaladhar/coupling/exchange.py (WF-2) against jaladhar.solver.acc.acc_step and jaladhar.solver.run.simulate
producer: WF-2 src/jaladhar/coupling/exchange.py - couple_step OWNS the full exchange for each dt: (1) inlet capture surface->nodes, (2) intra-graph edge routing node->edge->node, (3) surcharge return nodes->surface. Graph object is read-only topology+capacity.
consumers: G2 gate scorer via products/surcharge_events.csv + manifest

exchange_call.signature: couple_step(h, qx, qy, static, node_state, graph, dt) -> CoupleResult
exchange_call.call_site_order: host calls AFTER mass update h_new = h + div(fx)+div(fy)-b_out + rain*dt and BEFORE sink stage; returns h_new_coupled; infiltration applies after coupling return

CoupleResult_fields.node_state_new: NodeState(h_node_m:(N,) f32 head above invert proxy, vol_in_m3_cum:(N,) f64, vol_out_m3_cum:(N,) f64) out-of-place; N=graph.num_nodes

diagnostics.captured_depth_m: (H,W) f32 detached >=0 water leaving surface to nodes this step
diagnostics.returned_depth_m: (H,W) f32 detached >=0 surcharge re-entering surface this step
diagnostics.capture_m3: float64 = sum(captured_depth_m)*cell_area_m2 EXACTLY (host does not re-multiply)
diagnostics.surcharging_nodes: int count nodes where returned contribution >0 this step
diagnostics.cap_binding_this_step: int 0|1 whether either stability cap bound
diagnostics.edge_flow_m3s: (E,) f32 detached edge discharge positive downstream

edge_routing_pinned.algorithm: instantaneous capacity-limited transfer, zero delay within dt: Q_edge = min( available_vol_at_upstream_node/dt , q_capacity_nom_m3s[e] ); volume-conservative vol_up -= Q_edge*dt, vol_down += Q_edge*dt. NULL-capacity (synthetic connector) edges carry Q_edge=0 ALWAYS - topology only until owner assigns them capacity. MULTI-HOP PROPAGATION IS INTENDED: because routing follows topo_order within one host dt, captured water may traverse multiple edges per step (infinite-celerity abstraction, standard for capacity-limited instant routing); documented implication - surcharge timing at far nodes is not travel-time delayed
edge_routing_pinned.topology_order: strict downstream topological order from drain_graph_adjacency.json topo_order; consumer asserts manifest.graph_is_dag==true else refuse
edge_routing_pinned.multi_edge_rules: multiple inflows sum before outgoing capacity applied; multiple outgoing edges distribute proportional to q_capacity_nom over CAPACITY-BEARING outgoing edges ONLY (denominator excludes synthetic NULL edges); if the capacity-bearing denominator sum is 0, all outgoing Q_edge=0 (node retains volume)
edge_routing_pinned.no_substepping: graph advances on host adaptive dt only

node_storage_pinned.geometry_assumption_declared: vertical shaft proxy: node_plan_area_m2[i] = mean(width_m over CAPACITY-BEARING incident edges only; synthetic NULL widths excluded) * 1.0 m shaft-length proxy; isolated := count(capacity-bearing incident edges)==0 (including synthetic-only nodes) -> use tertiary nominal width 2.285 m. LABELLED declared-assumption v1 in manifest (assumed_uncalibrated=true), NOT a citation
node_storage_pinned.freeboard_basis: DECLARED ASSUMPTION v1, unsourced, pinned not tuned, versioned via coupling_version - NOT attributed to any standard (rule 1 discipline)
node_storage_pinned.invert_proxy: elev_m from drain_nodes (DEM-sampled); head h_node_m = vol_m3/node_plan_area_m2
node_storage_pinned.surcharge_activation: surcharge iff h_node_m > assumed_freeboard_m; street return head_diff = h_node_m - assumed_freeboard_m

sign_conventions.capture: positive = water leaves SURFACE cell into node; mirrors drained=min(cap*dt,h_new) acc.py:313
sign_conventions.surcharge_return: positive = water leaves NODE onto SURFACE cell; added like rain_rate_m_s*dt acc.py:280
sign_conventions.flow_direction: positive edge discharge = downstream along topo_order; node balance vol_new = vol_old + capture_at_node + edge_inflow - edge_outflow - return_vol
sign_conventions.diagnostics_sign: captured_depth_m>=0, returned_depth_m>=0 always; drain_out_net_m3 = capture_m3 - return_m3 may be negative (net return)

units.depth: metres; rates m/s x dt inside step never pre-multiplied by caller; Q_weir/Q_orifice m3/s; capacities m3/s
units.conversion_formulas_both: sink_mm_per_hr = q_capacity_m3s*3600000/contrib_area_m2 ; rate_m_s = q_capacity_m3s/contrib_area_m2 (contrib_area_m2 = contrib_area_cells*100.0 from drain_graph manifest)

mass_budget_entries.backward_compat_alias: when coupling_enabled=true MassBudget.as_dict() retains drain_out_m3 == drain_out_net_m3 so legacy queries/scripts do not break; uncoupled runs unchanged
mass_budget_entries.closure_rule_exact: residual = v_current - v_initial - rain_in + drain_out_net_m3 + infil_out_m3 + boundary_out_m3 - created_by_clamping_m3 ; relative_residual = |residual| / max(|rain_in|,|v_initial|,1e-12); tolerance 1e-3 unchanged; created_by_clamping EXACTLY 0
mass_budget_entries.accumulation: host passes diagnostics capture_m3/return_m3 (already volumes) into MassBudget.accumulate each accepted step

stability_constraints.per_step_capture_cap: captured_depth_m <= 0.9 * max(0, h_before_coupling - hf_floor_m) per cell via torch.minimum (extends acc.py sink-cap pattern with explicit margin)
stability_constraints.h_eff_definition_pinned: h_eff := max(0, h_before_coupling) - ponded depth at the cell feeding the inlet; regime switch: h_eff < 0.1 m -> weir equation, else orifice (inclusive lower bound weir)
stability_constraints.per_step_return_cap: node_available_vol_m3 := max(0, vol_m3 - assumed_freeboard_m * node_plan_area_m2) - the EXCESS above surcharge threshold only, so return can never drain a node below its activation head; returned volume at node <= 0.9 * node_available_vol_m3, distributed to street cell proportionally
stability_constraints.dt_policy: NO new CFL term; host TimestepController unchanged PROVIDED both caps enforced; cap bindings counted in cap_binding_steps (reported never silent)
stability_constraints.clamp_before_nonlinearity: all sqrt/pow heads floored at hf_floor_m=0.001 BEFORE evaluation - same discipline as solver hf clamp (acc.py hf_floor trap)

autograd_rules.out_of_place_only: no in-place mutation of h/qx/qy/node_state or frozen StaticFields; gradients MUST flow through capture+return for replay() calibration
differentiable_terms: Q_weir = Cw * L_weir * max(h_eff, hf_floor)^1.5 unsubmerged (h_eff per stability_constraints definition)
Q_orifice = Cd * A_open * sqrt(2 g max(head_diff, hf_floor)) submerged
regime switch h_eff < 0.1 m weir else orifice; Cw=1.7 Cd=0.65 (FHWA HEC-22 / EPA SWMM Ref Manual Vol II forms; page locators confirmed during WF-2)
L_weir and A_open use width_m_mean := mean width over capacity-bearing incident edges, isolated fallback 2.285 m; A_open = width_m_mean * 0.1 inlet-opening proxy (declared assumption)
autograd_rules.v5_mutant_test_required: WF-2 ships test_coupling_gradients.py: (a) >=512x512 tile, >=100 steps, surcharge active; (b) finite non-zero grads w.r.t. capacity scaling; (c) demonstrated RED by mutating capture cap to .detach() or dead torch.where branch -> grad zero/NaN, mutation recorded beside test; scope stated per V7

coupling_mode.legacy_sink_replacement_binding: coupling_enabled=true => host MUST zero StaticFields.drain_cap_m_s (load_domain path or explicit assert (static.drain_cap_m_s==0).all() at couple_step entry) - prevents double-count with legacy unconditional sink (state.py:247, acc.py:313); coupling_enabled=false => legacy behaviour byte-identical to today
coupling_mode.manifest_flag: coupling_enabled bool + coupling_version string pinning assumed_freeboard_m + capacity_rule_version + graph fingerprint; consumers refuse unflagged coupled runs

g2_anti_vacuity.aggregated_condition: manifest carries total_surcharging_steps = count(steps with surcharging_nodes>0) and total_returned_m3 = sum(return_m3); coupled run FAILS G2 if total_surcharging_steps==0 OR total_returned_m3 < 1.0 m3 - regardless of all other scores
g2_anti_vacuity.per_node_table: products/surcharge_events.csv columns [node_id,total_returned_m3,first_step,last_step,max_head_m]; G2 consumes exactly this file; zero-row file allowed but then G2 fails per condition above
g2_anti_vacuity.scope_statement_v7: evaluated at design condition (buffered domain, duration>=7200 s, design storm per configs/solver.yaml); smoke runs exempt but labelled PARTIAL naming the gap
g2_anti_vacuity.timed_tile_run_amendment_owner_2026_08_2: the G4 feasibility tile run must use the COUPLED solver at ITS OWN realized dt schedule - prior arithmetic (28.1 min worst-window) assumed dt~0.69 s from the replay#2 sidecar; owner notes realized dt 0.48 s on the promoted Phase-3 surface and coupling may lower dt further; treat all pre-measurement G4 numbers as scenario-dependent bands, never point estimates

manifest_guarantees_producer_writes: coupling_enabled + coupling_version (pins freeboard assumption version + capacity_rule_version + graph_fingerprint)
captured_to_drains_m3, surcharge_returned_m3, drain_out_net_m3 (+ alias drain_out_m3), relative_residual recomputed with extended formula, tolerance 1e-3
node_geometry_assumption block {node_plan_area rule, assumed_freeboard_m:1.5, basis:'declared assumption v1', assumed_uncalibrated:true}
rationale: Every integration surface quoted from realized code (verified this session): sink min(cap_m_s*dt,h_new) sits OUTSIDE any local no_grad block INSIDE acc_step (acc.py:312-316) - the host wraps simulate() in torch.no_grad() during recording and differentiability comes via replay() over the recorded schedule, so coupling terms must likewise be replay-safe out-of-place ops; mass.py residual formula extended verbatim with alias preserving cross-run comparability; legacy sink unconditional => replace-not-compete is forced, competition would double-count drainage ~2x; clamp-before-nonlinearity extends existing hf_floor discipline to sqrt heads; DAG assertion closes the cycle hole D8-through-basins could open; SWMM rejected on data grounds (.inp needs pipe inverts we lack - rule 1) and differentiability grounds (external stepping breaks replay).
open_questions: Capture allocation among multiple nodes sharing one cell (121 P+S crossing candidates): nearest-node-wins with stable tie-break by node_id - pinned here as default, revisit only if WF-2 evidence shows misallocation
A_open = width_mean*0.1 inlet opening proxy is a declared assumption - sensitivity swept via coupling_version bump if G2 timing proves sensitive
